scope: Technical whole-world surface qualification with localized native and installed west-front fire repair review. Existing tower and washer renders retained for unchanged assets. No human acceptance or whole-building visual completion.

images.observation: Production roof view shows the complete round tank, catwalk, retained footings and fitted service mast. This shadowed view establishes installed composition, not brightly lit finish judgment.
Neutral native assembly review: enamel vessel and slotted chamber, dark braced steel, fitted pipe connections, brass controls and retained collector.
Low native view confirms opaque returned rim and visible underside, with no sky leak through the sheet.
Native detail shows inspection slot, float/linkage, open discharge outlet and separate collars/valve materials; runtime authority remains the original service owner.
Complete native washer installed in retained laundry anchor, seated shoes, new tub/frame/wringer and original supply connections. Production light reviewed; neutral images establish finish detail.
New galvanized deck, seated valve supports, clean brass unions, separate native enamel wringer and fitted swivel. No floating mounts or cover/post intersection.
Seated gearbox and motor cradle, separate brass clutch levers, centered shaft hardware and structural angle legs with new clean custom PBR finishes.

Neutral native view shows sole boards, four supported timber uprights, fitted ledgers, separate planks, toe boards, guards and alternating diagonal braces against retained shell; source-fitted replacement window heads and toothed brick reveals. Shell-only review omits the runtime window owners.
Installed daylight entrance stays clear; staging reads along the building-frame west wing. The tall recessed court and mismatched masses remain a visual limitation, not accepted as complete.
Installed upper view retains the roof bridge and existing wings, with partial renovation staging. Central blank mass needs another architectural pass.
